在所有人的目光看向王野时，他的脸瞬间就发热了。太踏马丢人了，恼羞成怒的王野用力的把手里的烟扔在地上大骂一声：“看你爹呢看。”

伴随着骂声王野犹如一发炮弹一样冲了出去，站在前面陈少峰的衣服都被王野带飘动起来了。王野几步就冲到了楚材面前，这次他可没用铁山靠。

这要是一招儿上去，楚材不死也重伤。他是借助这股迅猛的惯力，如苍鹰扑兔般牢牢抓住楚材的衣服。紧接着，他顺势一扭腰下身猛的一沉，像座山般以泰山压顶之势，将楚材狠狠的按在地上。

说时迟那时快，王野这一套动作在电光火石之间就结束了，两面百十号人全都愣住了。躺在地上的楚材，在接触地面的瞬间就晕了过去。

王野早就用精神力探查过对方的人了，这些还算守规矩，除了被按在地上的楚材，剩下的人都没有拿刀子，大部分拿的都是棍子，只有少数几个人拿的是钢管儿。

在众人愣神儿的功夫，王野已经冲进了对方的人群。左手精准的扣住一个站在最前，拿着钢管人的手腕，发力扭转，迫使对方握钢管的手松开些许。同时，王野的右手像钳子一般，紧紧的卡住钢管儿，借势猛的一抽。

对方显然没料到这突如其来的攻击，还未来得及做出反应，那根原本紧握的钢管儿，已被王野成功夺下。整套动作行云流水般的自然流畅。

秦天熙最先反应过来，一声令下，四五十号人冲了过来。王野接下来就如狼入羊群，再加上他精神力全开。基本上一棍子就有一人倒地，对于明劲巅峰的王野来说，就算是他只用三分力都够他们受得。

再加上曹强这个大块头，形势呈现一面倒的惨烈局面。王野一方如同汹涌澎湃的潮水，以排山倒海之势向楚材一方席卷而去。

陈少峰等人的攻击迅猛而连贯，拳脚如雨点般落下，每一击都带着十足的力量和狠劲。楚材一方则像暴风雨中脆弱的芦苇，毫无还手之力。有人刚想反抗，就被对方一记强有力的飞踢踹倒在地，摔了个四脚朝天。

在混乱的人群中，强势的一方像是一群饥饿的野狼扑入羊群。他们配合默契，有的用胳膊肘狠狠撞击对手的胸口，发出沉闷的声响；有的抓住对方的头发，用力把人往地上摔。而处于劣势的人只能用手护住头部，在雨点般的攻击下蜷缩成一团，不断地后退、躲避。

呼喊声和求饶声交织在一起，整个场面仿佛是一场残酷的狩猎，一方是无情的猎人，另一方是绝望的猎物，胜利的天平完全倒向了王野他们。

随着秦天熙大喊一声住手后，所有人都停下了手上的动作。秦天熙在倒地的人中找到了楚材，蹲在旁边居高临下说道：“怎么着？还敢跟我们叫板吗？”

楚材捂着胸口，怒目而视：“别以为你们赢了就了不起，今儿个算我们栽了，可这事儿没完！”

陈少峰上前推搡着楚材：“嘿，还嘴硬呢！不服接着来啊，看我们不把你打得更惨！”

楚材挣扎着站起来：“行，你们等着，我们肯定找回场子！”

秦天熙不屑地笑道：“哼，随时奉陪！下次可别又被打得这么惨，让人笑话。”

说完秦天熙大摇大摆的带着众人走了，还没走出去多远，王野焦急的跟秦天熙说道：“大哥，大哥快点呀。”

When everyone looked at Wang Ye, his face instantly heated up.It was so embarrassing that Wang Ye was so angry that he threw the cigarette in his hand to the ground and cursed: "Look at your father."

With the curse, Wang Ye rushed out like a cannonball. Chen Shaofeng's clothes standing in front were fluttered by Wang Ye.Wang Ye rushed to Chu Cai in a few steps. This time he didn't use the iron mountain to support him.

If Chu Cai were to attack with one move, Chu Cai would be seriously injured even if he didn't die.He relied on this rapid inertial force to firmly grasp Chu Cai's clothes like an eagle attacking a rabbit.Immediately afterwards, he twisted his waist and sank suddenly, pressing Chu Cai to the ground like a mountain.

In a matter of seconds, Wang Ye's set of actions ended in a flash of lightning, and all the people on both sides were stunned.Chu Cai, who was lying on the ground, fainted the moment he touched the ground.

Wang Ye had already used his mental power to detect the other party's people, and they were fairly well-behaved. Except for Chu Cai, who was pinned to the ground, the rest of them didn't hold knives. Most of them held sticks, and only a few held steel pipes.

While everyone was stunned, Wang Ye had already rushed into the opponent's crowd.His left hand accurately latched onto the wrist of the man standing in front, holding the pole, and twisted it with force, forcing the opponent's hand holding the pole to loosen slightly.At the same time, Wang Ye's right hand was like a pliers, tightly clamping the steel pipe, and he used the force to pull it sharply.

The opponent obviously did not expect this sudden attack, and before he could react, Wang Ye successfully snatched the steel pipe that he was holding tightly.The whole set of movements was as natural and smooth as flowing water.

Qin Tianxi was the first to react. With an order, forty or fifty people rushed over.Wang Ye then acted like a wolf among sheep, and his mental strength was at full strength.Basically, one person would fall to the ground with just one stick. For Wang Ye, who was at the peak of Ming Jin, even if he only used three points of force, it would be enough for them.

Coupled with the big guy Cao Qiang, the situation becomes one-sided and tragic.Wang Ye's side was like a surging tide, sweeping towards Chu Cai's side with overwhelming force.

The attacks by Chen Shaofeng and others were swift, violent and coherent, with fists and kicks falling like raindrops, and each blow was full of power and ferocity.Chu Cai's side was like a fragile reed in a storm, unable to fight back.Just as someone was about to resist, he was knocked to the ground with a powerful flying kick and fell onto his back.

In the chaotic crowd, the stronger party is like a pack of hungry wolves pounced on the sheep.They cooperated tacitly, some hit their opponent's chest hard with their elbows, making a dull sound; some grabbed the opponent's hair and threw him to the ground hard.Those at a disadvantage could only protect their heads with their hands, huddle up in a ball under the rain of attacks, and keep retreating and avoiding.

Shouting and begging for mercy were intertwined, and the whole scene seemed like a cruel hunting. One side was the ruthless hunter, and the other side was the desperate prey. The balance of victory completely tipped towards Wang Ye and the others.

After Qin Tianxi shouted to stop, everyone stopped what they were doing.Qin Tianxi found Chu Cai among the people who fell to the ground, squatted next to him and said condescendingly: "What's the matter? Do you still dare to challenge us?"

Chu Cai covered his chest and glared angrily: "Don't think that it's a big deal if you win. Today, we are defeated, but this matter is not over yet!"

Chen Shaofeng stepped forward and pushed Chu Cai: "Hey, you are still being stubborn! If you don't obey, come on. Let's see if we don't beat you even worse!"

Chu Cai struggled to stand up: "Okay, just wait, we will definitely get back the situation!"

Qin Tianxi smiled disdainfully and said, "Huh, I'm always with you! Don't get beaten so badly next time and make people laugh."

After saying that, Qin Tianxi led everyone away in a swaggering manner. Before they had gone far, Wang Ye anxiously said to Qin Tianxi: "Brother, please hurry up."
